title: Execution Plan
description: Wave-based story execution plan produced by /split. Each story is a build-ready unit for /build. No JIRA fields; dependencies are a plain list of story ids.

release.description: Release name; matches the planning/<release-name>/ directory.

totalStories.description: Count of story records across all waves.

max_parallel.description: Maximum number of stories to dispatch concurrently within a wave. Stories beyond this limit queue and run as earlier ones finish.

summary.description: One-to-three sentence statement of what the epic delivers.

path.description: Path to the epic.md file, relative to the release directory.

waves.description: Dependency-ordered waves. All stories in a wave may run in parallel up to max_parallel.

max_parallel.description: Per-wave override of the top-level max_parallel.

title.description: Story title; mirrors the story.md H1.

estimateHours.description: Effort estimate in hours. Target ~1 (low end of the 1-2h band in standards/process/TASK_SIZING.md); 2 is the hard ceiling before splitting into sub-tasks.

path.description: Path to the story.md file, relative to the release directory.

type.description: Story delivers user or operator-visible value; Task is technical work with no direct visible value; Sub-task is a split of a parent story that exceeded the 2h ceiling.

dependencies.description: Story ids that must complete before this story starts. The full set must form a DAG (no cycles).

acceptanceCriteria.description: Acceptance criteria in given/when/then form. One primary criterion per story (see standards/process/TASK_SIZING.md).

subtasks.description: Present only when a story exceeded the 2h ceiling and was split. Ids use the parent id plus a letter suffix (e.g., story-001-001a).
